maria_cs: Ok team — onboarding call with Nebulon tomorrow 08:30PT. They want Dedicated pool commissioned with steady 250 RPS headroom and autoscale floor 6 -> max 24. Need a short commissioning protocol: quota mapping, autoscale tweak, smoke + soak + stress tests, and rollback criteria. Can ops own the runs? Also need billing confirmation.

jonah_ops: I can run smoke + soak. Plan: smoke 5m @50rps to sanity-check, soak 30m ramping to 250rps, then a 10m stress spike. Need quota id + KMS access. @liam_sre can you reserve extra nodes for the interval?

liam_sre: reserving 2 extra nodes in us-west-2 for 09:00-11:00 PT tomorrow. Autoscale policy currently target_util 65% — for the test we should lower to 50% to avoid oscillation. I'll submit a patch and link the PR.

tasha_se: Heads-up: Nebulon payloads have variable context. Median seq ~120, p95 ~512. Recommend enabling prefix cache and a conservative KV cache window to cut cold-start regen. I'll post cache params.

raul_ml: We'll serve a quantized v1.3 variant to match token throughput. I'll pre-compile kernels for seq512 and run a local dry-run with synthetic traffic; will upload perf artifacts before the test.

jonah_ops: load script I'll use (wrk):
```bash
wrk -t8 -c200 -d00:30s --latency -s scripts/chat_payload.lua -- https://dedicated.redwood.internal/neb/predict
```
Payload rotates 3 prompt buckets (short/medium/long) to exercise KV caching.

maria_cs: Great. Quota check: customer quota 76321 — can someone confirm mapping to pool + billing code? @deploybot

deploybot: billing mapping: 76321 -> nebula-prod-us -> NB-ENT-2024 ✅

liam_sre: PR submitted to patch autoscale: target_util -> 50, min_replicas -> 6, max_replicas -> 24. PR #4217. Will watch for thrash and can rollback.

tasha_se: For the run, set prefix cache TTL 10m, max entries 8k, and enable small-key dedupe. I'll push the config change to the test namespace.

jonah_ops: Proposed windows: smoke 09:05-09:10, soak ramp 09:20-09:50 (gradual ramp to 250rps), stress spike 09:55-10:05 at 350rps. Ops will stream metrics and logs to #eng-runtime and share Grafana link.

maria_cs: Action items: (1) Jonah — execute tests and collect artifacts, (2) Liam — reserve nodes + monitor autoscale, (3) Raul — upload compiled kernels + perf numbers, (4) Tasha — publish priming config and short how-to. I'll send Nebulon a concise runbook. Any rollback criteria to add?

liam_sre: Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx rate > 1% for > 2 minutes OR p99 latency > 2s for > 3 minutes -> revert autoscale policy and scale down to safe baseline (6 replicas) and abort test.

jonah_ops: Add billing guard: abort if projected billing burn for test window exceeds expected by > 10% or quota error spikes.

maria_cs: Noted and added to the runbook. I'll schedule a 15m post-test sync at 10:20PT to review artifacts and decide next steps. Thanks everyone :pray:

deploybot: Runbook link (auto-generated): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nebula-commissioning-1766667999 :rocket: 

maria_cs: perfect — closing here unless something blocks.
